## Funded research

**2025–2028 — Tartinians in Europe: The School of Nations and its Networks.** Principal Investigator (successor to initial PI). FWF-funded project. Total project award: €640,000. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.55776/PIN5035023).

**2025–2030 — Unlocking the Schematismus.** Consortium member. FWF-funded project. Total consortium award: €1.5 million. [DOI](https://doi.org/10.55776/FG3100).
